decisions.reason: The source enables regular Enter for the headline field only; the date field already has its separately established entry method and remains unchanged.
Enabling regular Enter in the headline field does not alter field labels, help-text content, locations, or persistence.
The source concerns headline line-entry behavior, not automatic placeholder removal when a field is activated.
The headline Enter option does not change the requirement to keep editable fields visibly identifiable.
Allowing regular Enter in a headline field does not entail any change to preservation of Title-field formatting during interaction.
The source approves a specific headline input behavior and does not change the selected field architecture or editable-text mechanism.
A regular Enter option permits explicit line entry but does not change the separate requirements for automatic word wrapping and column stability.
The headline Enter option does not affect the checklist-and-dropdown control configuration.
The source changes headline input behavior without changing Danish labels or placeholder text.
Enabling Enter for the headline does not alter the required spacing between text and the right-side border.
The headline input change has no effect on required theme colors or the available color-option policy.
Regular Enter input for a headline field does not entail changing the separate behavior whereby Enter creates a bullet in designated bullet fields.
